data.long_meaning: In Persian culture, Omideh symbolizes the lady of the house, the woman who takes care of her family and home. This name is rich in spiritual meaning, as it also represents the tranquility and peace that comes from nurturing and caring for loved ones. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Omideh usually hope their child will grow to embody lady of the house and live with faith, good character and purpose.
